config.label: Luxor API key (starts with lx_; tk_ is still accepted)
config.description: Luxor API key (starts with lx_; tk_ is still accepted). Alternatively set TENKI_AUTH_TOKEN (an ory_st_ session token or session cookie); the header is chosen by token prefix. LUXORAI_* names are read first.

config.label: Override the control-plane endpoint
config.description: Override the control-plane endpoint. Defaults to https://api.tenki.cloud (the same API as https://api.luxor.ai).
